title: Crunchyroll Confirms Attack on Titan Theatrical Run for Exclusive Finale Event
content: Based on the acclaimed Shonen manga by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity after its debut in 2013. The series was initially adapted by the renowned WIT Studio and released the first three seasons of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars Visions: Tsukumo Manga Debuts at San Diego Comic-Con in July
content: Creator duo Eiichi Shimizu and Tomohiro Shimoguchi announced on their joint X (formerly Twitter ) account on Monday that their Star Wars Visions: Tsukumo manga will launch at San Diego Comic-Con in July. The Japanese version's release will be announced at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Anime Fans Are Heartbroken One of The Biggest Series Isn’t Streaming Anywhere
content: In this age of streaming, old and new anime series alike have found numerous homes. Streaming services such as Crunchyroll , Netflix, HIDIVE, Hulu, and HBO Max are just a few examples of platforms for the ever-growing medium.

title: Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero, Trails to Azure Games Get Switch 2, PS5 Releases
content: NIS America announced on Tuesday that it will release The Legend of Heroes : Trails from Zero and The Legend of Heroes : Trails to Azure games for Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 this fall.
author: ANN

title: Top 5 Creepiest Zombie Anime, Ranked
content: When it comes to horror, the genre can often be seen as overlooked within the anime world, and for good reason. While many stories that were made by master of horror Junji Ito have received anime adaptations, there are more than a few creepy campfire tales that are nowhere to be found in the medium.

title: 14 Years Later, Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Underrated Sports Anime
content: Launched in 2017, the streaming platform Crunchyroll has risen through the ranks to become the biggest hub for anime fans worldwide. Naturally, this means that a large plethora of anime series can be found on the platform, including new ones that are being released every week.

title: Sound! Euphonium Releases SunFes Performance Scene
content: Sound! Euphonium anime released the performance scene of Kitauji High School in the Sunrise Festival (SunFes for short) marching band event that appeared in the first part of the Sound Euphonium Final Movie . The second part of the movie is set to release in Japanese theaters on September 11, 2026.
